findings.failure_path: The doc claims 'No case changed consensus status' and presents a paired before/current table as a measured comparison, but both raw reports record baseline_comparable=null, baseline_incomparable_reason=null, newly_failed=[] and newly_passed=[]. The runner never executed a paired comparison; the empty delta arrays are defaults, not evidence of no change. The impact register row citing this anchor then treats an unrun comparability check as a green paired result.
findings.smallest_fix: State that the runner reported baseline_comparable=null (paired comparison not executed) and that the table is a manual side-by-side of two independent runs, or rerun with the baseline flag so baseline_comparable is true.

findings.failure_path: The code-review row's bank-evidence locator points to specs/continuation-control/routing-evidence.md, a file created by this same commit, which certifies routing-after.json, also added by this same commit. The register's rule only forbids citing the register file itself, so same-commit sibling evidence passes the gate while providing the same self-certification the rule was added to prevent.
findings.smallest_fix: Mark the bank-evidence as same-packet self-authored (or make the gate reject firing paths added in the same round as the row) and cite the runner command plus report SHA-256 as the primary locator.

findings.failure_path: The seven entry-owner rows each assert 'An applied removal of that trigger failed its owning assertion; unchanged and restored controls passed' but supply only a bare script filename with no invocation, exit codes, assertion name or receipt hash, and the owning SKILL.md files are absent from this packet. Acceptance demands executable reproducible failure evidence; the gate exit 0 only validates locator shape, so an unexecuted or failed mutation is indistinguishable from a passing one.
findings.smallest_fix: Replace the bare filename with the exact command, failing assertion identifier and baseline/restored exit codes per row, or downgrade result-class to unverified until receipts are committed.

findings.failure_path: Neither report contains a run timestamp, resolved provider/model id, bank file path, catalog root or command line. The only difference between the arms is the code-review description hash and one clarify flag, both report-body fields, so the claim that these are two arms run on 2026-09-07 with the same runner and timeout is unverifiable; a later regenerated report would be indistinguishable.
findings.smallest_fix: Emit and commit run metadata (started_at, resolved model id, bank path/sha, catalog root commit, argv, runner sha256) in both report JSONs.

findings.failure_path: The single normative bullet ('must preserve the frozen five-case bank ... same runner and ten replicas') has no executable check in the packet, yet the register row anchors on it as bank-evidence. findings.smallest_fix: Bind the bullet to a check asserting both reports share bank_sha256, replicas and runner sha256 and that per-skill description hashes differ only for code-review, and reference that check from the bullet.

concern_results.conclusion: Falsified on three axes. (1) Paired comparability is asserted, not measured: both raw reports carry baseline_comparable=null, baseline_incomparable_reason=null, newly_failed=[] and newly_passed=[], i.e. the runner's paired-diff logic never ran, yet routing-evidence.md states 'No case changed consensus status' as a measured result. (2) Raw-report reconstruction is not self-authenticating: neither JSON contains a run timestamp, resolved model id, bank path, catalog root or command line, so the two files cannot be shown to be two distinct arms from the claimed date rather than one re-emitted run; the only link is prose committed alongside them. (3) The gate anchor check is not a mutation observation: the full-tree gate exit 0 validates owner/anchor/declared-evidence shape only, while all eleven added rows report mutation outcomes with no receipt hash, no artifact path and no command locator, and eight anchor into SKILL.md files absent from this packet.

The register's own anti-self-citation rule is bypassed by relocation: the code-review row's bank-evidence points at specs/continuation-control/routing-evidence.md, a bullet created by this same commit, which in turn certifies routing-after.json, also added by this same commit. Nothing in the file-path exclusion prevents a same-commit sibling from serving as external-looking evidence, so the packet self-adjudicates its routing claim. Separately, no changed file states the 'all three source partitions land together' constraint acceptance depends on; that exists only in untrusted profile prose, so this partition is landable alone with no committed rule blocking it.
